sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach are 1st with 22 points from 10 games and have won 7 of their last six matches before the defeat, so they remain strong title favourites despite the blip. Alsager Town arrive in poor form at the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 games, having won only once this season, making them heavy underdogs in this encounter.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) travel to Dawley Town on Saturday as the main chasing force in the title race, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host fellow promotion contenders Eccleshall in an important mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, welcome struggling Wednesfield Community to a fixture that offers them a chance to close on the leaders, before hosting Brereton Social in a Wednesday evening replay. Bilston Town, fifth on 17 points, travel to Foley Meir in a competitive mid-table encounter. In-form Barnton (15 points) visit Shawbury United, who have lost their last five consecutive matches and sit near the bottom. New Mills head to Market Drayton Town in a clash between mid-table sides, while Crewe entertain Allscott Heath and Telford Town travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads in lower-table battles. Brereton Social (11 points) face Widnes Town at home, with both sides needing wins after recent poor form. Widnes remain pointless from the league leaders' perspective, having managed just 2 points from 7 games.
